Two distinct incomparable maximal elements therefore rule out a greatest element.

title: Subset lattice

The remaining incomparable pair S3,S6 has join S1 and meet S7. Hence every pair has a unique join and meet, so this poset is a lattice.
The absent set {b} does not by itself prevent a lattice: bounds are taken within the given poset.

checkpoints.conceptNote: All comparisons and bounds are taken within the stated poset. Maximal/minimal do not mean greatest/least, and lattices require a join and meet for every pair.
